bouts.name: The Warm-up Act
bouts.intro: The Emperor sends in a drunk with a fish. Do not lose to the drunk with a fish.

bouts.name: Gold Rush
bouts.intro: The Emperor throws gold for 45 seconds. Two recruits want it too. Grab the coins!

bouts.name: Brutus the Bouncer
bouts.intro: He guards the gates. He is very large. He has a door-sized hammer.

bouts.name: Pork Chops
bouts.intro: Three boars. They only know one direction: forward.

bouts.name: The Pack
bouts.intro: Wolves and hyenas circle. Stand back to back.

bouts.name: The Big Lion
bouts.intro: The Emperor's favourite pet. Its roar knocks grown men over.

bouts.name: The Hound of Hades
bouts.intro: Three heads. It dies when the last one comes off. Mind the other two while you chop.

bouts.name: The Shield Wall
bouts.intro: Four shields. Flank them, kick them, or cry.

bouts.name: Gone Fishing
bouts.intro: Retiarii with nets. Cut your friends loose.

bouts.name: The Champion
bouts.intro: The rival school's best. He has heard about you.

bouts.name: Crocodile Pit
bouts.intro: Two gladiators and two crocodiles. Watch your ankles.

bouts.name: Chariot Race
bouts.intro: Survive 60 seconds. The chariots have scythes on the wheels.

bouts.name: The Elephant
bouts.intro: It walks in a circle. It stomps. It does not care.

bouts.name: The Griffin
bouts.intro: Half eagle, half lion, all claws. It pounces from above. Cut the wings and it is just a big cat.

bouts.name: Whimsical
bouts.intro: A new decree every 30 seconds. Good luck.

bouts.name: The Pit
bouts.intro: Scorpions and spiders. Stingers and claws come off like everything else.

bouts.name: Hot Potato
bouts.intro: A lit bomb. Whoever hits someone passes it on. It explodes.

bouts.name: The Executioner
bouts.intro: He brought two doctors. Kill the doctors first.

bouts.name: The Hydra
bouts.intro: Four heads on four necks. Take them all, or it keeps biting.

bouts.name: Bring Me His Head
bouts.intro: Brutus II insulted the Emperor. Kill him and carry his head to the Emperor's box.

bouts.name: Escort the Senator
bouts.intro: A drunk senator must cross the arena alive. He insists.

bouts.name: The Minotaur
bouts.intro: Twice your size, an axe to match, and it does not stop. Take a leg.

bouts.name: The Cyclops
bouts.intro: Three times your size. Only the eye takes full damage. Chop the legs.

bouts.name: The Mammoth
bouts.intro: A mountain with tusks. The tusks come off. So do the legs, eventually.

bouts.name: The Praetorian Guard
bouts.intro: The Emperor's own guard. Armored, disciplined, rude.

bouts.name: Hold the Circle
bouts.intro: Stand in the Emperor's circle until the crowd is satisfied.

bouts.name: The Dragon
bouts.intro: It breathes fire after it rears up. Cut the wings, then the head. Bring water.

bouts.name: The Titan
bouts.intro: Three times a man, armored, with a shield the size of a wall. Chop what you can reach.

bouts.name: The Emperor
bouts.intro: Golden armor. A gilded mace. He cheats.

bacchus.name: Bacchus
bacchus.desc: Permanently a little drunk, but immune to concussion.

venus.name: Venus
venus.desc: The crowd adores you: double favor.

pluto.name: Pluto
pluto.desc: Once per Day, you come back from death.

janus.name: Janus
janus.desc: Eyes in the back of your head: hits from behind do 60% less.

fortuna.name: Fortuna
fortuna.desc: A random effect every bout. Some are great. Some are a chicken.

fortunes.text: Fortuna smiles: you are huge today
Fortuna smiles: the strength of ten men
Fortuna laughs: you had wine for breakfast

pot.name: Starter pot
pot.desc: Start every run with a thunder pot (more per level)

reroll.name: Market connections
reroll.desc: One free market reroll per visit

bread.name: Bakery contract
bread.desc: Start every run with bread (more per level)
